step_by_step_reasoning: 1. Identify actors and client applications on the far left: Mobile App (UserConsumerMobile) and User/Web (UserConsumerWeb). 2. Identify core backend GraphQL API layer: AppSync receiving requests from Mobile App over GraphQL. 3. AppSync invokes Lambda functions (Velocity Template Language VTL routing) which perform CRUD operations on DynamoDB. 4. Identify IoT ingestion component on the top right: ResMed IoT Platform (ThirdParty) publishing real-time device data to Kinesis Data Streams, which writes transformed data into DynamoDB. 5. Identify notification pipeline from DynamoDB Streams: DynamoDB triggers a handwritten Lambda icon, which processes anomaly/sleep data and publishes messages to an SNS topic. 6. Identify static asset distribution components at the bottom: CloudFront CDN and S3 bucket. 7. Map all visually explicit directional arrows to graph edges with appropriate sequence numbers and flow IDs.
